title: 本校114年4月3日至4月5日進行病媒蚊防治消毒工作The school will carry out pest mosquito control and disinfection measures between April 3rd and April 5th, 2025.
content:
分類： 行政公告
來源： 總務處環境保護組 - 許智翔 - cocco3746@gms.ndhu.edu.tw - 電話03-8906399
對象： 全校教職員_全校學生
標題： 本校114年4月3日至4月5日進行病媒蚊防治消毒工作The school will carry out pest mosquito control and disinfection measures between April 3rd and April 5th, 2025.
日期： Tue, 25 Mar 2025 09:05:48 +0800

一、為維持校園環境衛生及防止病媒蚊孳生，預定於4月3日至4月5日施作建築物室外之消毒工作。
二、消毒日期及地點如下：
(一)、4月3日（星期四）：圖書資訊大樓、行政大樓、大門、藝術學院、管理學院、理工(一、二、三)館、湖畔餐廳周邊建築、育成中心、景觀廁所、學生活動中心、原住民民族學院、東華會館、藝術工坊、環境學院、環境解說中心、污水廠（含 69KV開關廠）。
(二)、4月4日(星期五):西區學生宿舍（向晴莊、涵星莊、仰山莊、擷雲莊、多容館）、東區學生宿舍（迎曦莊、沁月莊、行雲莊、集賢館）。
(三)、4月5日（星期六）：志學門、司令台、游泳池、體育館、幼兒園、校長宿舍、東華園、學人宿舍（素心里、居南邨圍牆外圍2m~3m噴藥及水溝投藥）、花師教育學院、人社(一、二、三)館。
(四)、如遇雨天順延並另行公告施作時間。
三、消毒期間請勿靠近並請配合關閉一、二樓對外門窗，造成不便，敬請見諒。
​
總務處環境保護組 敬啟
A、To uphold campus environmental sanitation and control vector mosquito propagation, exterior disinfection of buildings will be conducted between April 3rd and April 5th.
B、The disinfection dates and locations are as follows:
(a)、April 3rd (Thursday): Library and Information Building, Administration Building, Main Gate, College of Arts, College of Management, College of Science and Engineering (Buildings 1, 2, and 3), Buildings surrounding the Lakeside Restaurant, Incubation Center, Landscape Toilets, Student Activity Center, College of Indigenous Studies, Tung Hwa Hall, Art Workshop, College of Environmental Studies, Environmental Interpretation Center, Sewage Treatment Plant (including 69KV Switchyard).
(b)、April 4th (Friday):
West Campus Student Dormitories (Xiang Qing Zhuang, Han Xing Zhuang, Yang Shan Zhuang, Jie Yun Zhuang, Duo Rong Hall)
East Campus Student Dormitories (Ying Xi Zhuang, Qin Yue Zhuang, Xing Yun Zhuang, Ji Xian Hall)
(c)、April 5th (Saturday): Disinfection will take place at the Zhi Xue Gate, Command Post, Swimming Pool, Gymnasium, Kindergarten, President's Residence, Tung Hwa Garden, Faculty Dormitories (Su Xin Li, Ju Nan Cun - spraying 2m~3m outside the walls and applying medicine to the ditches), Hua Shi College of Education, and the College of Humanities and Social Sciences (Buildings 1, 2, and 3).
(d)、In the event of rain, the disinfection will be postponed and the rescheduled date will be announced separately.
C、Please do not approach during the disinfection and please cooperate to close the external doors and windows on the first and second floors.
Environmental Protection Division, Office of General Affairs, NDHU
